login.title: Sign in to rooster
login.subtitle: Use the account your organisation gave you.
login.inviteOnly: rooster is invite-only. New here? Ask for an invite link.

noProviders.title: No sign-in options yet
noProviders.body: No sign-in provider is configured. Ask the person who runs this rooster to set one up.

not_invited.title: You’re not on the list yet
not_invited.body: That account isn’t invited. Ask someone in your organisation for an invite link.

disabled.title: Your account is disabled
disabled.body: An administrator has turned off this account. Contact them to get access again.

invite_invalid.title: That invite no longer works
invite_invalid.body: It has expired, been revoked or already been used. Ask for a new link.

failed.title: Sign-in didn’t work
failed.body: Something went wrong with the provider. Try again in a moment.

notInvited.title: You’re not on the list yet
notInvited.body: rooster is invite-only, and this account isn’t invited.
notInvited.bodyWithEmail: rooster is invite-only, and {email} isn’t invited.
notInvited.askLink: Ask someone in your organisation to send you an invite link.
notInvited.askAdmin: Or ask the administrator to add your email address or domain.

disabled.title: Your account is disabled
disabled.body: An administrator has turned off this account. Contact them to get access again.

unverified.title: Verify your email first
unverified.body: Your sign-in provider hasn’t confirmed this email address. Verify it there, then try again.

invite.title: Join {org}
invite.failed: Couldn’t accept the invite. Try again.

expired.title: This invite has expired
expired.body: Invites to {org} last a limited time. Ask for a new link.

revoked.title: This invite was revoked
revoked.body: An owner of {org} withdrew it. Ask them for a new link.

used.title: This invite has been used
used.body: It was a single-use link. Ask an owner of {org} for a new one.

notFound.title: Invite not found
notFound.body: Check that you copied the whole link.

invite.emailMismatch: This invite is for a different email address.
